subject: HyperGrid — post-discovery architecture deep-dive: time options & prep
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Turner <elliot.turner@hypergrid.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: HyperGrid — post-discovery architecture deep-dive: time options & prep

Hi Elliot —

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — really helpful to understand HyperGrid's throughput targets and security constraints. Per our discussion, we'd like to run a focused architecture deep-dive to validate inferred topology, KV cache expectations, and the proposed routing/fallback plan.

Proposed goals for the session (60–75 minutes):
- Review current call pattern and latency targets (QPS, p95).
- Walk through recommended topology (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private).
- Discuss caching/batching and quantization trade-offs for cost targets.
- Surface security/observability requirements (audit logs, KMS).
- Align on next steps and mutual action plan.

Availability — pick a slot that works for your team (all times PST):
- Tue Dec 8 — 10:00–11:15am
- Wed Dec 9 — 8:30–9:45am
- Thu Dec 10 — 1:00–2:15pm

Attached a short agenda and a draft session runbook for our engineers to review. If you prefer, you can pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-soojin/hypergrid-arch-deepdive

Prep items from our side (we can own these if you prefer):
- A sample request/response trace for a representative workload (anonymized)
- Expected concurrency/QPS table by endpoint
- Any network egress/ingress constraints (VPC peering, corporate firewall)

If you can confirm attendees and a preferred slot, I’ll send a calendar invite and a brief pre-read.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Pre-Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Attachments: HyperGrid_deep-dive-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page); redwood-session-runbook-draft.md (markdown, 4 pages)

From: Elliot Turner <elliot.turner@hypergrid.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@hypergrid.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HyperGrid — post-discovery architecture deep-dive: time options & prep

Thanks Soojin — this looks great. Priya (cc'd) will join from our infra team.

Wednesday Dec 9 at 8:30am PST works best for us. We may need the session to run a full 75 minutes since we have a couple of integration questions around S3-presigned flows and our internal token rotation.

Quick question: will your team need VPN access to our staging environment or can we share a small anonymized trace? We prefer not to open VPN for a discovery/deep-dive if possible.

Also, Elliot here — could you confirm whether you typically cover the Dedicated sizing calc in the same session or if that’s a follow-up?

—Elliot
Elliot Turner
Head of Infrastructure, HyperGrid
elliot.turner@hypergrid.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: HyperGrid deep-dive — confirmed Wed 12/9 08:30am PST (pre-call prep)

Folks —

HyperGrid confirmed Wed 12/9 at 8:30am PST for a 75-minute deep-dive. Attendees from HyperGrid: Elliot Turner (Head of Infra) and Priya Shah (Infra engineer). They flagged integration questions on S3-presigned flows and token rotation and prefer not to open VPN — they’ll share an anonymized trace and some sample QPS numbers prior to the meeting.

Can we do the following prep:
- Karthik: lead the session and own the Dedicated sizing discussion + batching/quantization trade-offs.
- Marissa: capture runbook notes and produce the final post-call mutual action plan.
- Soojin (me): I’ll provide the pre-read and the sample session runbook (attached).

A couple of logistical items:
- We may need one engineer with access to the runbook and metrics dashboard during the call (console.redwood.ai).
- Please review the draft runbook I attached and comment inline by EOD Monday 12/7.

Attachments: redwood-session-runbook-draft.md

Thanks — I’ll send the official invite once Karthik confirms.

Soojin

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HyperGrid deep-dive — confirmed Wed 12/9 08:30am PST (pre-call prep)

Sounds good — I’ll lead. A few notes from my side:

- Plan: 10–15 minute recap of discovery -> 30–35 minute architecture walkthrough (topology variants + sizing calc) -> 20 minute live Q&A and next steps. We should be explicit about the assumptions in the sizing calc (avg tokens, p95 latency target, KV cache hit rate).
- I’ll prepare a short slide with the Dedicated sizing calc and a fallback routing diagram (hosted -> dedicated -> private) so HyperGrid can see trade-offs.
- Marissa: please be ready to capture any items that would require Legal/Procurement (eg. specific SLA windows or data residency asks).

I’ll upload the slides and a 1-page assumptions sheet to our shared Drive by EOD Friday.

Karthik
